subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should the Trim OS packaged Gateway auth/config regeneration be handled as an OpenClaw core Gateway repair, a package-owner follow-up, or held until logs identify the failing protocol frame?
rationale: The reported workaround and possible fixes touch Gateway device pairing and shared-auth boundaries, while the repository does not appear to contain the Trim OS package manager that allegedly rewrites config.

options.title: Collect proof before changing auth
options.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the failing connect frame or `PROTOCOL_MISMATCH` details, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and the regenerated config before choosing a code or package fix.

options.title: Core diagnostic/docs repair
options.body: If logs show an opaque current-client protocol or device-auth failure, improve Gateway/CLI diagnostics and docs without loosening pairing defaults.

options.title: Route package config behavior
options.body: If the only reproducible bug is `trim.openclaw` rewriting config outside this tree, keep core auth strict and route config-management changes to the package owner.

recommendation.title: Collect proof before changing auth
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the failing connect frame or `PROTOCOL_MISMATCH` details, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and the regenerated config before choosing a code or package fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across gateway protocol compatibility, gateway-client extraction, device-pairing docs, and release-adjacent gateway behavior.
